name: Oviedo / Uviéu

queries.query: Oviedo Spain official cadastral map parcel viewer GIS catastro Ayuntamiento Oviedo
queries.result: Found the official Spanish Directorate-General for Cadastre portal and the official Principado de Asturias parcel ArcGIS REST service. The Asturias service is described as cadastral base data and exposes annual parcel layers, including Parcelario 2025, with JSON and GeoJSON query support.

queries.query: Oviedo catastro mapa parcelas visor oficial Sede Electrónica Catastro Principado Asturias
queries.result: Se encontró el visor oficial del registro de planeamiento del Principado y el servicio ArcGIS oficial de Parcelarios de Asturias. El servicio publica Parcelario 2025 y declara referencia espacial EPSG:25830; la ayuda oficial del Catastro documenta la visualización y descarga de parcelas.

registry.custodian: Principado de Asturias, official geographic information service; national cadastral custodian is Dirección General del Catastro
registry.scope: Regional public parcel-map service covering Asturias, with annual parcel layers. This is evidence of a public cadastral/map source available for Oviedo, not a citywide census result.
